{{CharInfobox |color={{Let's Go Pikachu color}} |corecolor={{Let's Go Pikachu color light}} |bordercolor={{Let's Go Pikachu color dark}} |name=Pikala |jname=ピカーラ |tmname=Pikala |slogan=no |image=Pikala.png |size=250px |caption=Pikala |colors=yes |eyes=Hazel |hair=Orange |gender=Female |hometown=[[Pikachu Valley]] |region=[[Alola]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=no |age=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=SM091 |epname=A Plethora of Pikachu! |java=[[Saki Fujita]] |enva=[[Emily Cramer]] }} '''Pikala''' (Japanese: '''ピカーラ''' ''Pikala'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[SM091|A Plethora of Pikachu!]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who lives in [[Pikachu Valley]] with all of her {{p|Pikachu}}. ==History== Pikala debuted in ''[[SM091|A Plethora of Pikachu!]]'', where she met {{Ash}}, {{an|Kiawe}}, and [[Mimo]] when they visited [[Pikachu Valley]]. To give her visitors the full experience, she gave them each Pikachu-themed ears and tails to wear as well as giving them their own "Pika-speak" names, '''Pikash''' (Japanese: '''サトピ''' ''Satopi''), '''Pikawe''' (Japanese: '''カピ''' ''Kapi''), and '''Pikamo''' (Japanese: '''ホピ''' ''Hopi''), respectively. Later, when {{TRT}} attempted to steal all of the Pikachu, Pikala, with the help of her {{Shiny}} Pikachu, [[nickname]]d the Boss, sent the trio blasting off using {{m|Catastropika}}. She reappeared during a flashback in ''[[SM114|Beauty is Only Crystal Deep!]]'', where she had her [[Pikanium Z]] stolen by a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Pheromosa}}. In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', Pikala entered the [[Manalo Conference]] with another one of her Pikachu, named '''Bolt''' (Japanese: '''ボルト''' ''Bolt''). However, it was defeated by [[Jessie's Mimikyu]] during the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round, thus eliminating Pikala from the tournament. ==Character== Pikala is an eccentric fan of {{p|Pikachu}}. She even dresses up in a Pikachu outfit and puts "Pika" into all of her sentences, referring to this manner of speech as "Pika-speak". She also has the ability to know which [[region]] a Pikachu comes from by touching their fur. ==Pokémon== ===At Pikachu Valley=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pikala |pkmn=Pikachu (multiple) |type1=Electric |img=Pikachu Valley Pikachu.png |epnum=SM091 |epname=A Plethora of Pikachu! |vajp=Mika Kanai |vajp2=Chika Fujimura |vajp3=Kei Shindō |vajp4=Hitomi Kikuchi |vaen= |desc=All of the {{p|Pikachu}} living in Pikachu Valley belong to Pikala. Each individual Pikachu has their own nickname, such as '''Red Cheeks''' (Japanese: '''アカホッペ''' ''Akahoppe'') and '''Pretender''' (Japanese: '''カッコ''' ''Kakko''). When the Pikachu first encountered [[Ash's Pikachu]], they were initially cautious of him, as he was from [[Kanto]]. However, they soon warmed up to him and shared their electricity with him. They later got caught by {{TRT}}, but were saved by the Boss's {{m|Catastropika}}. None of the Pikachu's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pikala |pkmn=Pikachu |nick=Curly |type1=Electric |gender=female |img=Curly.png |epnum=SM091 |epname=A Plethora of Pikachu! |vajp=Nicole Fujita |vaen=Emily Cramer |desc=This {{p|Pikachu}}, known as '''Curly''' (Japanese: '''クリン''' ''Kurin''), is one of Pikala's Pokémon. According to Pikala, Curly received her [[nickname]] due to her curly bangs. In Japanese, it is instead because her hair resembles chestnuts. Curly was the first of Pikala's Pikachu to approach [[Ash's Pikachu]] and act friendly with him, much to the Boss's dismay. She and the other Pikachu were later caught by {{TRT}}, but were saved by the Boss's {{m|Catastropika}}. None of Curly's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pikala |pkmn=Pikachu |nick=Boss |shiny=yes |type1=Electric |gender=male |img=Boss.png |epnum=SM091 |epname=A Plethora of Pikachu! |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Akio Suyama |vaen=Pete Zarustica |desc=This Pikachu, known as the '''Boss''' (Japanese: '''バンチョー''' ''Banchō''), is one of Pikala's Pokémon. He is highly regarded amongst the other Pikachu in Pikachu Valley and appears to be Pikala's main battling partner. He is a {{Shiny}} Pokémon and slightly taller than others of his kind. In ''[[SM091|A Plethora of Pikachu!]]'', upon seeing Curly act friendly with [[Ash's Pikachu]], the Boss became jealous and fired bolts of electricity at Pikachu. The two Pikachu then engaged in a battle, which the Boss lost, earning Pikachu his respect. Afterwards, the valley was attacked by {{TRT}}, who caught all other Pikachu. However, the Boss was able to sent the trio blasting off using his [[Z-Move]], {{m|Catastropika}}. He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[SM114|Beauty is Only Crystal Deep!]]'' as a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Pheromosa}} stole Pikala's [[Pikanium Z]]. The Boss's known moves are {{m|Thunderbolt}} and {{m|Volt Tackle}}.
The Boss can also perform the [[Z-Move]] {{m|Catastropika}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pikala |pkmn=Pikachu |nick=Bolt |type1=Electric |gender=male |img=Bolt.png |epnum=SM129 |epname=Battle Royal 151! |vajp= |vaen= |desc=This {{p|Pikachu}}, known as '''Bolt''' (Japanese: '''ボルト''' ''Bolt''), is one of Pikala's Pokémon. He first appeared in ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', where he was used in the [[Manalo Conference]]. He interrupted a battle between a {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s {{p|Magikarp}} and another Trainer's {{p|Pyukumuku}}, attacking Magikarp and knocking it out. Soon after, Bolt was defeated with a single {{m|Shadow Ball}} from [[Jessie's Mimikyu]].
